title: Jim Ryder's talk "The Garment of God"
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jim Ryder's talk "The Garment of God", about an unknown time at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: urge everyone to listen to this talk Jim Ryder gave called the Garment of God
He was speaking at this event for Lucus Trust
tellings.difference: Places the talk at a Lucis Trust event and calls Ryder a Lockheed VP, but does not give the talk's title.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about a talk by Lockheed's Jim Ryder that Jesse Michels points listeners to; the Garment of God talk is plausibly the one given at the Lucis Trust event.

as_told.title: Lockheed VP Jim Ryder's talk at a Lucis Trust event

tellings.quote: And he gave a very interesting speech called the Garment of the Gods.
tellings.difference: Titled 'Garment of the Gods' and tied to Lockheed Martin Space Systems rather than a Lucis Trust event.
tellings.link_reason: The same speech by Jim Ryder, there called 'The Garment of God'.

as_told.title: Jim Ryder's 'Garment of the Gods' speech

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, urges people to hear a talk by Jim Ryder, whom he calls a vice president at the aerospace company Lockheed, titled "The Garment of God." He says Ryder gave it at an event for the Lucis Trust, a spiritual group, though another time he calls it "Garment of the Gods" and links it to Lockheed's space division. Michels points to it because, coming from a defence insider, it would hint at hidden spiritual ideas inside that world.
